label: ext.blocktype ext.source
createStatement: CREATE (b:ext.blocktype {id: $id, name: $name, properties: $properties, requiredProperties: $requiredProperties, semantics: $semantics, status: $status})

createParameters.name: ext.source

properties.code: the file content: a string for text sources, or the blob reference object (_kind: blob, hash, mediaType, size, optional filename) for binary assets uploaded through CCGW's blob surface
properties.hash: content hash of the file bytes, sha256:<hex>; for a binary source it equals the blob reference's hash
properties.language: the source language; absent for binary sources
properties.path: relative file path within the extension
properties.rootMapped: optional; true materializes the Block to <path> at the working-tree root instead of src/extensions/<extId>/<path>; root-mapped paths are reserved for elevated-review extensions

createParameters.semantics: A source file as a versioned Block. Materializes to src/extensions/<extId>/<path>, or to the working-tree root when rootMapped — which is how the shell owns package.json, the pnpm lockfile, vite.config, and the framework entry files. A binary source embeds its asset as code holding the blob reference object; consumers branch on the value's shape, and the materializer fetches the bytes through CCGW's blob route, verifying the hash.
